name: Ezetimibe
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Ezetimibe and Simvastatin (ezetimibe), Clinical Pharmacology 12.3 Metabolism and Excretion - t½ ≈ 22 h
halfLifeNotes: Applies equally to parent ezetimibe and its active glucuronide; plasma profiles show multiple peaks from enterohepatic recycling, and exposure is higher in hepatic impairment.
